title: IEEE Xplore Digital Library
short_description: IEEE Xplore provides full-text discovery and access to more than 6 million research papers, peer-reviewed journals, transactions, conference proceedings, technical standards, and educational courses.

title: NISB - NIE IEEE Student Branch Official Portal
short_description: Official portal of the NIE IEEE Student Branch (NISB) at The National Institute of Engineering, Mysuru, Karnataka, India. Established in 1999 under the IEEE Bangalore Section and IEEE Mysore Subsection, organizing Adroit, Ankura, WIE events, and technical workshops.

title: IEEE Bangalore Section
short_description: One of the premier and most active IEEE Sections in Region 10 (Asia-Pacific), founded in 1976. Oversees Student Branches, Subsections (Mysore, Mangalore, North Karnataka), and technical society chapters across Karnataka.

title: IEEE Region 10 (Asia-Pacific)
short_description: IEEE Region 10 (R10) covers the Asia-Pacific area, spanning India, China, Japan, Australia, New Zealand, Singapore, and Southeast Asia, serving hundreds of thousands of members and student branches.

title: IEEE vTools Portal
short_description: Official IEEE organizational and management platform used by Student Branches, Sections, Subsections, and Chapters to record meetings, officer elections, activity reports, and event registrations.

title: IEEE Standards Association (IEEE-SA)
short_description: The official consensus building organization that develops globally recognized market-driven IEEE standards including IEEE 802.3 (Ethernet) and IEEE 802.11 (Wi-Fi).

title: IEEE Membership Portal (Join & Renew)
short_description: Official IEEE portal for creating membership accounts, joining IEEE as a professional or student member, selecting technical societies, and renewing annual memberships.

title: IEEE Collabratec
short_description: IEEE Collabratec is an integrated online community and collaboration platform that connects global technology and engineering professionals for networking, authoring, and sharing research.

title: IEEE ResumeLab (Career Portal)
short_description: An exclusive career-building tool for IEEE members offering professional resume builders, portfolio templates, and mock interview practice.

title: IEEE Conferences Search Portal
short_description: Comprehensive searchable directory of over 1,900 international IEEE conferences, call for papers (CFP), submission deadlines, and conference proceedings.

title: IEEE Technical Societies Directory
short_description: Official directory of the 39 specialized IEEE technical societies and councils spanning computer science, robotics, power systems, communications, and electronics.
